topic.title: Extended Processor Signature Table Verification

body.p: The extended processor signature table (MCU extended header) is a structure that may be appended to the end of the encoded data when the encoded data only supports a single processor signature (optional case). The extended signature table will always be present when the encoded data supports multiple processor steppings and/or models (required case).

Legacy BIOS might opt-out the verification due to the MCU content was meant to support a single processor signature. For this platform, BIOS is required to verify the extended processor signature table for multiple processor signatures support.
